snippet.title: Vivid World | 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vivid World is now available as a VER 1.0 on Steam!

▼About Vivid World
A follow-up to the hit game Vivid Knight, Vivid World is a completely new party-building, roguelike strategy game! Our story takes place in the Underworld, a land ruled by demons. Utilize and master our protagonist, Lemuria's new Jewel Magic to conquer strange dungeons.

▼Steam Store
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468550/Vivid_World/?utm_source=off&utm_campaign=fr&utm_medium=yt&utm_content=video&utm_term=en_002

▼Official Discord Server
https://discord.gg/csDtSpH7BA
